source.text:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Definition
1 In this Schedule, "spur road", in relation to a particular road, means the following: (a)a road that begins at a junction with the particular road and ends at a point other than a junction with another road; (b)a road that begins at a junction with a spur road of the particular road and ends at a point other than a junction with another road.
